ei.title: Chapter 4-11 3번: Red — A Color of Impact and Rarity
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: Of all the colours of the rainbow the one that makes the greatest impact on the eye is red. There is something instantly arresting about the colour of fire and danger. It is charged with alarm and urgency. We have red fire engines, red warning lights and the Red Cross. If we want something to be seen from a distance, such as a post box or (formerly) a telephone kiosk, we paint it red. Perhaps it is because red is so obvious that few wild animals are truly red: even the so-called Red Squirrel and the Red Deer are really shades of reddish-brown that conceal rather than advertise. Relatively few butterflies are red either. In Britain, and indeed, in all mainland Europe, only one species has a pattern of full-on bright red, like a splash of blood: the Red Admiral.

questions.passage: Of all the colours of the rainbow the one that makes the greatest impact on the eye is red. There is something instantly (A)[arresting / boring] about the colour of fire and danger. It is charged with alarm and urgency. We have red fire engines, red warning lights and the Red Cross. If we want something to be seen from a distance, such as a post box or (formerly) a telephone kiosk, we paint it red. Perhaps it is because red is so (B)[obvious / hidden] that few wild animals are truly red: even the so-called Red Squirrel and the Red Deer are really shades of reddish-brown that (C)[conceal / reveal] rather than advertise. Relatively few butterflies are red either. In Britain, and indeed, in all mainland Europe, only one species has a pattern of full-on bright red, like a splash of blood: the Red Admiral.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① arresting — hidden — conceal (B 반대: 명백한→숨겨진)
✅ ② arresting — obvious — conceal — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ boring — obvious — conceal (A 반대: 시선을 끄는→지루한)
❌ ④ arresting — obvious — reveal (C 반대: 숨기다→드러내다)
det.tip: arresting(시선을 끄는) ↔ boring(지루한), obvious(명백한) ↔ hidden(숨겨진)

questions.passage: Of all the colours of the rainbow the one that makes the greatest (A)[impact / indifference] on the eye is red. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① indifference — urgency — advertise (A 반대: 영향→무관심)
❌ ② impact — calmness — advertise (B 반대: 긴급함→침착함)
❌ ③ impact — urgency — conceal (C 반대: 알리다→숨기다)
✅ ④ impact — urgency — advertise — 원문 일치 ←정답
det.tip: impact(영향) ↔ indifference(무관심), urgency(긴급함) ↔ calmness(침착함)

questions.passage: Of all the colours of the rainbow the one that makes the greatest impact on the eye is red. There is something instantly arresting about the colour of fire and danger. It is (A)[charged / free] with alarm and urgency. We have red fire engines, red warning lights and the Red Cross. If we want something to be seen from a distance, such as a post box or ((B)[formerly / currently]) a telephone kiosk, we paint it red. Perhaps it is because red is so obvious that few wild animals are truly red: even the so-called Red Squirrel and the Red Deer are really shades of reddish-brown that conceal rather than advertise. Relatively few butterflies are red either. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① charged — formerly — species — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② free — formerly — species (A 반대: 가득 찬→없는)
❌ ③ charged — currently — species (B 반대: 이전에→현재)
❌ ④ charged — formerly — categories (C 유사: 종→범주, 의미 다름)
det.tip: charged with(~으로 가득 찬) ↔ free from(~이 없는), formerly(이전에) ↔ currently(현재)

questions.passage: Of all the colours of the rainbow the one that makes the greatest impact on the eye is red. There is something instantly ①<u>arresting</u> about the colour of fire and danger. It is charged with alarm and ②<u>urgency</u>. We have red fire engines, red warning lights and the Red Cross. If we want something to be seen from a distance, such as a post box or (formerly) a telephone kiosk, we paint it red. Perhaps it is because red is so obvious that few wild animals are truly red: even the so-called Red Squirrel and the Red Deer are really shades of reddish-brown that ③<u>expose</u> rather than advertise. Relatively few butterflies are red either. In Britain, and indeed, in all mainland Europe, only one ④<u>species</u> has a pattern of full-on bright red, like a splash of blood: the Red Admiral.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean:
① arresting(시선을 끄는) ✅ 빨강의 첫인상
② urgency(긴급함) ✅ 경보와 긴급함
③ expose(드러내다) ❌ → conceal(숨기다)이 원문 — 동물이 자신을 '드러내기'보다 '숨기는' 것
④ species(종) ✅ 한 종만이 밝은 빨강 패턴을 가짐
det.analysis:
① arresting(시선을 끄는): 빨간색에 대해 즉각 시선을 끄는 무언가 — 적절 ✅
② urgency(긴급함): 경보와 긴급함으로 가득 차 있다 — 적절 ✅
③ expose(드러내다): 원문은 conceal(숨기다). 야생 동물이 자신을 '드러내기'보다 '숨기는' 적갈색이라는 문맥 ←정답
④ species(종): 유럽 본토에서 한 종만이 밝은 빨강 — 적절 ✅
det.tip: conceal(숨기다) ↔ expose(드러내다)

questions.passage: Of all the colours of the rainbow the one that makes the greatest ①<u>impact</u> on the eye is red. There is something instantly arresting about the colour of fire and danger. It is charged with alarm and urgency. We have red fire engines, red warning lights and the Red Cross. If we want something to be seen from a distance, such as a post box or (formerly) a telephone kiosk, we paint it red. Perhaps it is because red is so ②<u>obscure</u> that few wild animals are truly red: even the so-called Red Squirrel and the Red Deer are really shades of reddish-brown that conceal rather than advertise. ③<u>relatively</u> few butterflies are red either. In Britain, and indeed, in all mainland Europe, only one species has a pattern of full-on ④<u>bright</u> red, like a splash of blood: the Red Admiral.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean:
① impact(영향) ✅ 눈에 가장 큰 영향을 주는 색
② obscure(모호한) ❌ → obvious(명백한)가 원문 — 빨강이 너무 '명백한' 색이라서
③ relatively(비교적) ✅ 비교적 적은 나비
④ bright(밝은) ✅ 완전한 밝은 빨강
det.analysis:
① impact(영향): 눈에 가장 큰 영향을 주는 색 — 적절 ✅
② obscure(모호한): 원문은 obvious(명백한). 빨강이 너무 '모호해서' 야생동물이 빨강이 아니라는 것은 인과관계 부적절 ←정답
③ relatively(비교적): 비교적 적은 나비가 빨강 — 적절 ✅
④ bright(밝은): 완전한 밝은 빨강 패턴 — 적절 ✅
det.tip: obvious(명백한) ↔ obscure(모호한, 잘 알려지지 않은)

questions.passage: Of all the colours of the rainbow the one that makes the greatest impact on the eye is red. There is something instantly arresting about the colour of fire and danger. It is charged with ①<u>alarm</u> and urgency. We have red fire engines, red warning lights and the Red Cross. If we want something to be seen from a distance, such as a post box or (②<u>formerly</u>) a telephone kiosk, we paint it red. Perhaps it is because red is so obvious that few wild animals are truly red: even the so-called Red Squirrel and the Red Deer are really shades of reddish-brown that conceal rather than ③<u>advertise</u>. Relatively few butterflies are red either. In Britain, and indeed, in all mainland Europe, only one species has a pattern of ④<u>faint</u> bright red, like a splash of blood: the Red Admiral.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean:
① alarm(경보) ✅ 경보와 긴급함으로 가득
② formerly(이전에) ✅ 이전에 전화 부스
③ advertise(드러내다) ✅ 숨기기보다 드러내다
④ faint(희미한) ❌ → full-on(완전한)이 원문 — 피 한 방울 같은 '완전한' 밝은 빨강
det.analysis:
① alarm(경보): 경보와 긴급함으로 가득 차 있다 — 적절 ✅
② formerly(이전에): 이전에 전화 부스였던 것 — 적절 ✅
③ advertise(드러내다): 숨기기보다 드러내다 — 적절 ✅
④ faint(희미한): 원문은 full-on(완전한). 피처럼 '희미한' 밝은 빨강은 문맥상 모순 ←정답
det.tip: full-on(완전한, 전면적인) ↔ faint(희미한)

det.tip: conceal = hide = cover up (숨기다, 감추다)

✅ ④ subtle(미묘한): obvious의 반의어 — 명백한 vs 미묘한 ←정답
det.tip: obvious(명백한) ↔ subtle(미묘한, 감지하기 어려운)

questions.passage:
(A) The colour red is <u>charged</u> with alarm and urgency, making it the most powerful signal of danger.

(B) The suspect was <u>charged</u> with armed robbery and taken into custody immediately.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 charged의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 청구되다 — (B) 돌진하다: (A)는 요금 청구가 아닌 감정의 충만
✅ ② (A) 가득 차다 — (B) 기소되다: (A) 경보와 긴급함으로 가득, (B) 무장 강도로 기소 ←정답
❌ ③ (A) 충전되다 — (B) 비난하다: (A)는 배터리 충전이 아님
❌ ④ (A) 기소되다 — (B) 가득 차다: (A)(B) 의미가 뒤바뀜
det.tip: charged with: ① 감정/특성으로 가득 찬 ② 범죄로 기소된 ③ 요금이 청구된

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a state of requiring immediate action or attention"

det.korean: 즉각적인 행동이나 주의를 요하는 상태 = urgency(긴급함)
det.analysis:
❌ ① alarm(경보): 위험을 알리는 신호이지 '즉각 행동 요구 상태' 자체는 아님
❌ ② impact(영향): 효과/영향이지 긴급 상태가 아님
✅ ③ urgency(긴급함): 즉각적인 행동/주의를 요하는 상태 — 정의 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ species(종): 생물 분류 단위
det.tip: urgency = 긴급함, 시급함 (immediate action needed)

questions.passage: There is something instantly __________ (arrest) about the colour of fire and danger. It is charged with alarm and urgency.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: something instantly _____ about — 'something + 형용사' 구문. arrest의 형용사형 arresting(시선을 끄는)이 적절. 현재분사가 형용사로 쓰이는 패턴.
det.tip: arrest → arresting (시선을 끄는, 눈길을 사로잡는) — 현재분사의 형용사적 용법

questions.passage: __________ (relative) few butterflies are red either. In Britain, and indeed, in all mainland Europe, only one species has a pattern of full-on bright red.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: _____ few butterflies — 부사가 형용사 few를 수식하는 구조. relative의 부사형 relatively(비교적)가 적절. 형용사 → 부사 변환(-ly 추가).
det.tip: relative(형용사: 상대적인) → relatively(부사: 비교적) — few를 수식하므로 부사 필요

questions.passage: Of all the colours of the rainbow the one that makes the greatest impact on the eye is red. There is something instantly arresting about the colour of fire and danger. It is charged with alarm and urgency. We have red fire engines, red warning lights and the Red Cross. If we want something to be seen __________, such as a post box or (formerly) a telephone kiosk, we paint it red. Perhaps it is because red is so obvious that few wild animals are truly red: even the so-called Red Squirrel and the Red Deer are really shades of reddish-brown that conceal rather than advertise. Relatively few butterflies are red either. In Britain, and indeed, in all mainland Europe, only one species has a pattern of full-on bright red, like a splash of blood: the Red Admiral.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① from a distance(멀리서): 우체통이나 전화 부스를 멀리서도 보이게 빨간색으로 칠한다 — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② in the dark(어둠 속에서): 빨간색의 가시성 이유이긴 하나 원문과 다름
❌ ③ under pressure(압박 속에서): 문맥상 무관
❌ ④ by accident(우연히): 우연히 보이게 칠한다는 것은 부적절
det.tip: seen from a distance = 멀리서도 보이도록

det.analysis:
